customer_name: Jinan No. 2 Machine Tool Group Co., Ltd.
business_problem: Jinan No. 2 Machine Tool needed to digitize production, quality inspection, maintenance and scheduling across a large CNC equipment business where fault monitoring, troubleshooting and planning still depended heavily on manual work and experience.
solution_summary: Jinan No. 2 Machine Tool adopted a Baidu AI Cloud smart-factory architecture with implementation support from Shensi Electronics to modernize the full manufacturing lifecycle around its CNC stamping equipment. The deployment combines cloud computing, AI and data-driven production management to digitize production, inspection, operation and after-sales workflows instead of treating them as isolated functions. A predictive-maintenance layer ingests operating signals from key production assets into an integrated real-time monitoring environment so the factory can detect and predict equipment faults, then pair those findings with remote expert guidance to accelerate diagnosis. On top of that foundation, the company built a smart safety-production monitoring platform and an AI-driven scheduling engine that optimizes production across large, medium and small-part workshops. The result is a unified plant stack that connects shop-floor telemetry, maintenance logic and production-planning intelligence into one operating model.

solution_components.name: Smart Manufacturing Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the overall digital-factory framework for production, quality, maintenance and service workflows.

solution_components.name: Predictive Maintenance Platform
solution_components.role: Monitors production lines in real time, identifies faults and predicts equipment failures.

solution_components.name: Smart Safety Production Monitoring Platform
solution_components.role: Uses AI models to detect safety risks across complex industrial scenarios.

solution_components.name: Scheduling Optimization Engine
solution_components.role: Uses AI algorithms to optimize production dispatching across multiple workshops.

data_flow: Production-line signals and operational data flow into the predictive-maintenance platform for fault detection and expert-assisted diagnosis, while production orders and workshop constraints feed the scheduling engine, and both streams surface through the smart-manufacturing control environment.
business_outcome: The manufacturer improved fault detection, safety monitoring and scheduling efficiency, giving its smart-factory program a practical foundation for higher throughput and less unplanned downtime.
metrics: AI-model development efficiency for safety scenarios improved about 30%.
